anchors.explanation: Unauthenticated requests (empty `who`) are limited to GET / and otherwise raise 401, so no case route is reachable without a session.
Both /case/{id} and /case/{id}/offer are parsed and resolved through store.get_case(db, who, cid) before any branch, making it the single principal gate.
Decisive authorization gate: row selected only WHERE id=? AND (owner=? OR officer=?), with `who` bound to both; otherwise 404. Denies other borrowers and unassigned officers.
Ordinary case route (op is None) served only after the get_case gate, with no further principal check and no bypass path.
Offer download served after the gate; the added stage/restriction condition is availability, not an access exception.
offer() returns case id, email, amount and term from the case object already restricted by get_case.
Contrast: owner-only check applies to access/portable, not to the ordinary case or offer routes; confirms the offer route relies solely on get_case.
Dashboard listing filters by owner or officer, consistent with the same permitted principal set.
